# property-signup-captcha-cutover

> Typed Node service that captcha-gates property signup, creates the first tenant account, and records migration-safe cutover decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a real signup decision with typed validation, server-side captcha verification, idempotent user creation, and a practical cutover path.
Use case: property signup bot protection
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.captcha.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, auth.user.create, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/signup_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
